note: Interface art (backgrounds, card back, icons): tools/generate_art.py --ui. Each card set keeps its own art direction in content/<year>/<month>/<set>/art/prompts.json.

cardback.prompt: The back of a collectible card for a card game about gentle folk creatures from around the world, in a soft stylised 3D look: a deep warm graphite field with a softly glowing pale-aqua medallion in the centre that blends folk motifs from many cultures (a papercut star flower, a Celtic knot ring, arabesque leaves, a small glowing tree of life at its heart), fine aqua and warm-white line ornament around it, a subtle rounded inner border with small corner flourishes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.

app-icon.prompt: A square app icon of Dziadzius, the Domowiki hero (drawn with his hero card, content/2026/10/domowiki/art/illustrations/DW1-H01-kitten.webp, as the style reference): the same painterly acrylic brushwork and face, a close-up of his head and shoulders filling the square, gentle warm smile, hugging a small round loaf of bread, the warm orange glow of his tiled stove behind him and violet shadows at the edges. Full bleed, no border, no text.

icon-settings.prompt: A single round cog wheel (settings gear) with eight chunky rounded teeth and a round hole in the middle, in warm caramel orange. Perfectly symmetrical. A single game icon drawn in a flat kawaii sticker style for a card game of folk creatures: bold clean dark outline of even thickness, flat colour fill with one soft highlight, no gradients, no texture, no 3D, no drop shadow. Centred, filling the frame with a small even margin, on a fully transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no extra objects, no background shapes.

icon-home.prompt: A single house icon (home button): a small cosy house with a pitched roof, a door and one round window, in warm caramel orange. Perfectly symmetrical. Flat game icon: bold clean dark outline of even thickness, flat colour fill with one soft highlight, no gradients, no texture, no 3D, no drop shadow. Centred, filling the frame with a small even margin, on a fully transparent background. No text, no animals, no faces, no extra objects.
